changelog: Upgraded /conf_acn_phone to a full-screen responsive Control Center adapted for 1080p, 2K, 4K, and Ultrawide screens with UI density selector and Ctrl+K command palette.

Rebuilt App Creation into the ACN App Studio with a 15-block Visual UI Designer, 10 starter templates, HTML/CSS/JS/Manifest Code IDE, live phone preview, Bridge API snippets, permissions, and JSON export/import.
Overhauled Players & Phones with live phone number editing, remote lock/wipe/reboot/PIN/SIM/content moderation, automatic stolen-phone detection, and real physical sender forensics attribution.
Added Command Center KPIs, live phone broadcasts, Config Integrity Scanner, SQL rollback snapshots, Audit Log v2, Sales Analytics v2, and bulk management tools.
